hotspots.descZh: 坑道內搖櫓賞淚，需預約；無光害，弱光也可見。
hotspots.descEn: Rowboat tours inside the tunnel (booking required); zero light pollution.

tips.zh: 需預約搖櫓船；坑道外步道可免費觀賞。
tips.en: Book the rowboat tour in advance; the outer walkway is free.

hotspots.accessZh: 南竿仁愛村，距梅石約 8 分鐘車程
hotspots.accessEn: Renai Village, Nangan; about 8 min drive from Meishi

hotspots.descZh: 突出海面的岩礁據點，面西南，浪拍岩壁時藍光明顯。
hotspots.descEn: Rocky outpost jutting into the sea; waves against the rocks light up well.

tips.zh: 岩石濕滑，請穿防滑鞋並留意浪況。
tips.en: Rocks are slippery; wear grippy shoes and watch the swell.

hotspots.accessZh: 南竿仁愛村，鐵堡停車場步行 3 分鐘
hotspots.accessEn: Renai Village, Nangan; 3 min walk from the Iron Fort car park

hotspots.descZh: 坑道出口直面海灣，可與北海坑道一起走訪。
hotspots.descEn: Tunnel exits face the bay; pair it with Beihai Tunnel.

tips.zh: 夜間坑道照明有限，請攜帶手電筒。
tips.en: Tunnel lighting is minimal at night; bring a torch.

hotspots.accessZh: 南竿仁愛村，鄰近北海坑道
hotspots.accessEn: Renai Village, Nangan; next to Beihai Tunnel

hotspots.descZh: 南竿西南角沙灘，光害低，退潮時可近距離踏浪觀賞。
hotspots.descEn: Beach on Nangan's southwest tip; low light pollution and easy wave-kicking at low tide.

tips.zh: 沙灘無路燈，請結伴前往。
tips.en: No street lights on the beach; go with company.

hotspots.accessZh: 南竿津沙村，距梅石約 10 分鐘車程
hotspots.accessEn: Jinsha Village, Nangan; about 10 min drive from Meishi

hotspots.descZh: 閩東石屋聚落下方海灣，面北，浪較小時需耐心等待。
hotspots.descEn: Bay below the stone village; faces north, so be patient on calm nights.

tips.zh: 聚落內有民宿與咖啡館，可邊等邊休息。
tips.en: Guesthouses and cafés in the village make waiting comfortable.

hotspots.accessZh: 北竿芹壁村，北竿機場車程約 10 分鐘
hotspots.accessEn: Qinbi Village, Beigan; about 10 min from Beigan Airport

hotspots.descZh: 北竿北側小漁港，船隻進出攪動水面時容易看見藍光。
hotspots.descEn: Small fishing harbour on Beigan's north side; boat wakes stir up the glow.

tips.zh: 漁港作業區請勿靠近船隻。
tips.en: Keep clear of boats in the working harbour.

hotspots.descZh: 馬祖最著名的藍眼淚沙灘之一，退潮沙灘寬闊，可踏浪觀賞。
hotspots.descEn: One of Matsu's best-known Blue Tears beaches; wide sand at low tide.

tips.zh: 鄰近東莒燈塔，可順道觀星。
tips.en: Dongju Lighthouse is next door for stargazing.

hotspots.accessZh: 東莒福正村，碼頭車程約 10 分鐘
hotspots.accessEn: Fuzheng Village, Dongju; about 10 min from the pier

hotspots.descZh: 東莒南側聚落海灣，光害極低，適合長時間守候。
hotspots.descEn: Bay by the Dapu settlement on Dongju's south; very dark skies.

hotspots.descZh: 西莒西側沙灘，面向開闊海域，藍眼淚季節常見整片發光。
hotspots.descEn: West-facing beach on Xiju; whole shoreline often glows in season.

tips.zh: 步道較陡，夜間注意腳步。
tips.en: Steep path; watch your step at night.

hotspots.descZh: 馬祖最北島嶼，海岸岩壁陡峭，安東坑道附近可觀賞。
hotspots.descEn: Matsu's northernmost island; steep cliffs, viewable near Andong Tunnel.

tips.zh: 東引風大，請注意保暖與安全。
tips.en: Dongyin is windy; dress warm and stay back from edges.

hotspots.accessZh: 東引中柳村，需搭臺馬之星或島際船班
hotspots.accessEn: Zhongliu Village, Dongyin; reach by Taima Star or inter-island ferry
